{{Quote|Nuso Esva's Eastern Fleet has been shattered, but he has two more of equal strength. I have to return immediately to seize our temporary advantage.|Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The '''Eastern Fleet''' was one of three [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] that formed the [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]] of [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]]. It was formed by twenty-seven [[Firekiln]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]], fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s, and nearly 100 of the Firekilns' [[Unidentified escort ship|escort]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. It was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by Esva.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Eastern Fleet participated in a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] against [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], and the [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet. The battle ended with the destruction of the fleet and Esva's retreat.

==Description==
{{Quote|Twenty-eight Firekilns against two Star Destroyers. Are you so frightened of me, Nuso Esva?''"<br />"''I fear nothing. You may hide behind your Imperial underlings if you wish, aboard that freighter, and allow them to die before you. But you will die. And when you are dead, I will batter the worlds below you into rubble.|Senior Captain Thrawn and Warlord Nuso Esva|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], part of<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]], was one of the three fleets of equal strength that formed the warlord's [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]]. The Eastern Fleet was composed of twenty-eight [[Firekiln]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessels']] [[Unidentified escort ship|escort]] starships, and fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s. The Eastern Fleet&mdash;which filled an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer's]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]]&mdash;was under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of Esva.<ref name="Choices" />

==History==
{{Quote|I mean to destroy you, Captain Thrawn. But first, your soldiers and subordinates are going to watch as you make your final, fatal choice. In fourteen minutes, unless something is done, the Chimaera and the Golan will destroy each other in a fiery collision. The other ships of your task force are helpless to interfere. I have all of them trapped here by Poln Minor, and should any of them attempt to leave their current positions my Firekilns have been ordered to intercept and destroy. The only way to prevent the collision is for either the Chimaera or the Golan to open fire and destroy the other.|Warlord Nuso Esva, to Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
As part of the [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|campaign]] developed by Esva to end [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|conflict]] with [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the warlord sent the Eastern Fleet to the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]<ref name="Choices" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="ChoicesD" /> with the goal of [[Battle of the Poln system|decimating]] Thrawn's [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']]&mdash;[[Flagship/Legends|led]] by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''&mdash;and the other Imperial forces, including the Imperial II [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Most of the fleet arrived at once, and four of its Firekilns arrived after Thrawn reported to Esva through [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] that Poln's [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] destroyed the Eastern Fleet's fifty Whisperlike [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] with its [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].<ref name="Choices" />

[[File:Executor-SWE.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought ''Executor'' (pictured) fought the Eastern Fleet.]]
As the fleet's vessels moved to their designated positions, the Chiss senior captain and the Storm-hair warlord continued speaking through comm. Esva claimed that once Thrawn's [[Death/Legends|death]] came, the Eastern Fleet would shatter the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] double [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Poln Major]] and [[Poln Minor]]. Once Esva's forces were in position, Thrawn summoned the [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], a fleet of Imperial Star Destroyers led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] from the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. Vader then ordered all of the Empire's forces present to engage the Eastern Fleet, destroying it. Esva, however, was able to flee aboard his [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]], the ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''.<ref name="Choices" />

==Commanders and crew==
The Eastern Fleet was commanded by Esva.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eastern Fleet appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
